audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly claims Pantheon's passive 'blocks your first auto or shuriken' (whys[0], spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[0]). audit.corrected: Block claims replaced with Mortal Will's empowerment; Shield Vault's stun-plus-auto-reset written into breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.trading.
